_note: DBF house editorial desks. These are transparent institutional bylines, not individual people. No desk here represents a named human reporter, and none may be presented as one. The About page discloses this. `type` must stay `house_desk` for every entry.

desks.name: DBF Coast & Nature Desk
desks.beat: Wildlife, ecology, marshes, dunes, weather, coastal systems, migration and conservation.
desks.description: Reporting on the Delaware coast as a living system — what moves through it, what shapes it, and what is changing.

desks.name: First State History Desk
desks.beat: Delaware history: Lenape homeland and Native history, colonial settlement, the Revolution, surveying and boundaries, political history, the Underground Railroad and war history.
desks.description: Long-form Delaware history, checked against primary and institutional sources.

desks.name: Delaware Life Desk
desks.beat: Homes, architecture, objects, traditions, culture, beach-house life and design.
desks.description: How Delaware actually lives — the houses, the objects, and the habits that come with them.

desks.name: Field Notes
desks.beat: Shorter observational and local pieces, practical local knowledge, scene-setting and walks.
desks.description: The things we would actually tell a friend before they go.

desks.name: Delaware Beach Finds Editorial
desks.beat: Institutional stories, explainers, corrections, editor's notes and publication-wide material.
